posts.title: Designing Audit-Friendly Financial Data
posts.excerpt: Why separating immutable source records from rebuildable reporting projections makes financial software easier to trust.
posts.body:
## Immutable Source Records vs. Reporting Projections

When building cooperative finance or POS systems, the most common source of accounting drift is mutating balance fields directly on every transaction. A single failed retry or partial update can silently leave totals out of sync.

Instead, treat every payment, allocation, custody movement, and adjustment as an **append-only source record**. Each event carries a timestamp, actor ID, and reference so every balance change can be traced.

## Rebuildable Projections

Summary tables—member balances, monthly contribution totals, and dashboard KPIs—become **derived projections** calculated from the source ledger. If a reporting bug is ever discovered, you fix the projection logic and rebuild the view without risking historical accuracy.

## Practical Benefits in Production

- **Clean audits:** Reviewers can trace every summary figure back to individual source events.
- **Safe exports:** Controlled PDF and CSV exports always reflect verified ledger state.
- **Simpler testing:** Pure aggregation functions can be unit-tested in isolation with Vitest.

posts.title: Two Years of Shipping MERN Apps: Lessons Learned
posts.excerpt: Practical lessons on shared validation, server-side RBAC, and query optimization from building production MERN applications.
posts.body:
## Share Schemas Between Client and Server

In a TypeScript monorepo, placing Zod validation schemas in a shared package ensures browser forms and Express API routes validate the exact same rules. You eliminate duplicated validation logic and catch payload mismatches at compile time.

## Enforce Access Control on the Server

Hiding admin buttons in React is a UX convenience, not security. Every protected endpoint should verify the authenticated user, check their role server-side, and support session revocation so compromised tokens can be invalidated immediately.

## Measure Performance Early

Using `.lean()` on read-only Mongoose queries, indexing frequently filtered fields, and pairing React Query caching with route code-splitting keeps production apps responsive under real-world traffic.
